answer: A new identity must show a government photo ID and take a live selfie in one session. A verification service matches the face to the portrait, checks the security marks, and confirms the ID was never used before, within 24 hours. A mismatch or reused ID rejects the application and flags the document. The pigment of a genuine ID cannot be copied; a canyon separates a live face from a printed mask. One honest user passes in minutes; an attacker needing a thousand fakes would need a thousand genuine documents, a prism no bot farm can afford.
